summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline only (37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown) with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings; analytics has permission/configuration gaps; revenue covers one day with $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission and cannot support ROI, margin, or causal claims. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry. Keep SearchWoot private. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all four remain open because complete evidence is absent. Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only artifact covering field-level rights, alert and operational data flows, log fields, retention, access, deletion, correction, notification consent/unsubscribe, vendors, and incident/request procedures, plus an unsent permission-request draft for owner and human-counsel review. Do not change the private gate or send outreach.

Data-use review detail: Woot source/purpose/processing/display and monetization use are blocked because API access is evidenced but storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, trademark/image/price use, affiliate use, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rights are not. Smallest action: create a field-level rights matrix and attach it to the unsent permission-request draft; human counsel must review before any rights-dependent launch or monetization. User alerts are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are missing; next action is a repository/deployed-configuration data-flow and retention table. GA4 is evidence_needed because deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction review are missing; next action is read-only configuration capture without enabling tracking. Operational logs are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and request procedures are missing; next action is a read-only operator/vendor inventory.

Approve only updates to existing execution-reconciliation, measurement, failed-run containment, security-evidence, and private-launch workstreams. No new proposal, production change, telemetry request, monetization expansion, external outreach, or launch change is justified this cycle. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional on site-specific consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims support, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and any age-sensitive or regulated-content review supported by the affected site.

Private or gated launch decision: keep SearchWoot private. Concrete blockers are missing upstream redistribution permission, incomplete privacy/data-flow evidence, blocked security and release acceptance, blocked accuracy/freshness controls, blocked attribution/measurement reconciliation, and absent owner disposition. The next evidence action is the consolidated read-only evidence artifact and unsent rights-request packet; no checklist task should be closed until its stated evidence is attached and unresolved issues are escalated to human counsel.
